existing_contract.reason: The current capabilities and SubmitRequest harness_id are const=codex. Root must version/freeze the actual multi-Harness interface before adding Pi; no renderer-only selector or model_config_ref substitution.
reusable_semantics: stable request idempotency and UNKNOWN reconciliation

native_transport.records: UTF-8 JSON objects terminated by LF; strip an optional preceding CR; U+2028/U+2029 are not record separators
native_transport.stdout: Continuously drain structured records with Host-owned byte/frame/deadline limits
native_transport.stderr: Separate bounded diagnostics; never a success protocol
native_transport.response_correlation: Match only a Host-issued id plus expected command; do not confuse responses with asynchronous events
native_transport.state_projection: Allowlist safe model/provider/session metadata. Do not forward or log the full native Model/config object unchanged.

dispositions.started: Accepted to start a native run; wait for actual events and terminal facts
dispositions.queued: Queued disposition only; not started or completed
dispositions.handled: Input/extension consumed the prompt; it may produce no run or settled event. Never invent a Run or wait forever for a run that did not start.

prompt.late_failure: After prompt acceptance, failure comes through events/messages, not a second response for that request id
prompt.unknown: No automatic prompt resend, new request, new session or harness fallback

native_event_mapping.agent_start: Native lifecycle observation, associated with the single Host-owned prompt/run only
native_event_mapping.message_update.assistantMessageEvent.tex: Optional reconstruction input; existing Host v1 may keep whole-message projection and token_delta=false
native_event_mapping.message_end: Authoritative final message; extract only allowed assistant text/tool outcomes
native_event_mapping.tool_execution_start/tool_execution_upda: Observed tool lifecycle; not a permission or business-acceptance grant
native_event_mapping.agent_end: One low-level agent run ended; retries/compaction/queued work may continue
native_event_mapping.agent_settled: No remaining automatic native work for that session-level run; still not OS child/stream cleanup proof
native_event_mapping.thinking_*: Do not project private thinking. Define redaction before storing/sharing native raw records.

cancel.reason: abort alone can continue queued messages; clear_queue must precede abort for a full stop
cancel.outer_completion: Close input/stop the owned Pi process as scoped, drain both streams, and prove exact owned process/job cleanup within a Host deadline. Native abort/settled are not that proof.

readonly_review.initial_option: No-tools review of Host-supplied fixed candidate/diff/check text
readonly_review.why: The installed read tool accepts absolute paths and expands home-relative paths; read-only tool names do not establish a filesystem allowlist or secret boundary.
readonly_review.filesystem_enforcement: UNVERIFIED; requires a separately reviewed mechanism and real Windows allow/deny evidence
readonly_review.extensions_and_resources: Root must reconcile --no-extensions/skills/templates/context flags with trusted platform/organization policy; never silently bypass required policy
readonly_review.candidate_drift: Reject review/acceptance binding on any input drift; no automatic reviewer repair or commit

session.proposed_first_use: Fresh per-Run process with --mode rpc --no-session; no attachment to old user sessions
session.no_session_scope: In-memory conversation only; does not disable auth/config reads or settings persistence
session.settings_mutators: set_auto_retry and set_auto_compaction call SettingsManager setters and can save global settings. Do not use them as an assumed side-effect-free handshake against the user profile.
